# DUM-SDK 0.14.2

- Upgrade the wire protocol to 5. Client and Paper must be updated together; HELLO keeps its stable protocol prefix.
- Validate complete catalogs before any requests/allocation, reject duplicate IDs/hashes and invalid metadata, and enforce contiguous nonempty chunks with final hash/signature checks and cached size validation.
- Reject repeated/unoffered jar requests and installation results outside their expected phase. Failed installs cannot later report success.
- Add stable error codes and module/detail fields to installation results, server-owned Russian descriptions and visible diagnostic codes. Preserve message-file overrides with fallback defaults for new keys.
- Add codec, transfer and message tests, plus a real client/Paper fault-injection game test. Aggregate memory/bandwidth budgeting and SDK capability negotiation are unchanged.

## Upgrade and validation

Update both the client and Paper plugin together: protocol 5 is incompatible with protocol 4 in SDK 0.14.1. SDK admission checks the protocol number, not the latest GitHub release.

Local macOS verification passed: 34 unit tests, six real client/Paper rejection scenarios and the ordinary successful module/reconnect game test. Windows/Linux client integration and the full old-protocol auto-update/restart scenario remain unchecked. Crash-log collection/upload is not part of this release.
